reason: A DeepSeek Harness utility plugin that prevents concurrent servers from sharing one DSH_HOME by acquiring a lock at startup and rejecting live conflicts.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 DSH_HOME 单实例锁的插件，用于阻止多个服务器同时使用同一数据目录。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that enforces one live server per DSH_HOME data directory by acquiring a startup lock and rejecting active conflicts.

capabilities: Creates and exclusively locks a file under DSH_HOME
Checks the liveness of the process recorded in an existing lock file
Removes stale lock files and retries acquisition once
Aborts startup when another live server uses the same DSH_HOME
